title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1985-09-07
lineage: Master Cassette > PCM > DAT > M-1 > 7-pin optical > Co2 > SB Live > CDwave Record > CE 200 FTT NR > CDwave Index > FLAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent 1985 soundboard recording that sounds cleaner and more balanced than the usual Charlie Miller source.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this SBD as a rare clean‑sounding source from an era known for spotty tapes, noting less tinny instrument levels and a well‑balanced mix. No specific musical comments are made, but the high rating reflects strong enthusiasm for the audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review is available; it is highly positive about the recording quality while offering no insight on performance, so rating leans toward strong recording but uncertain show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaner than typical Charlie Miller SBD, less tinny, more balanced instrument levels; considered a treat for an otherwise spotty 1985 tape era.
